# Edusphere Academy (Malaysia)

> Skills training academy in Taman Universiti, Skudai, Johor, Malaysia. Hands-on certificate courses in nursing aide, professional caregiving, hospital & healthcare administration, and barista arts.

- Hours: Monday–Sunday, 9:00am–6:00pm
